title: Chapter 327
text:
There were many opportunities in the Colton Star Cluster, and the Mercenary Alliance's database was the most direct indicator. Han Xiao had the advantage of being familiar with the storyline, so he could pick the missions that he was familiar with.

Becoming a freelance mercenary was a very good choice. He could earn money and come into contact with various organizations through missions. It was a free path to promotion.

However, Han Xiao's plan did not stop there. What he was going to do next was the real focus.

There was an option on the mercenary interface that said 'Build a Mercenary Group'. Han Xiao clicked on it without hesitation.

"Do you want to build a mercenary group?"

As the name suggested, a mercenary group was a small team of mercenaries that could accept missions with a certain number of people. Furthermore, the mercenary group had a rating system, and the actions of the members would be recorded.

Missions completed by individual members would also be counted into the mercenary group's rating. Similarly, if a member did something negative, it would also affect the mercenary group's credit rating. Han Xiao's mercenary resume was blank, and so was his mercenary group.

The Sky Ring Army was a super-large mercenary group that accepted large-scale missions. Their business was very wide, and countless members contributed to them. They had a very high reputation.

As long as they did not have a criminal record, anyone could build a mercenary group. One person could only build one mercenary group. Unless the original mercenary group disbanded, a new one could not be built.

"Please fill in the name of the mercenary group."

After thinking about it, Han Xiao simply named it 'Black Star Mercenary'. After confirming the creation, the interface changed from the personal interface to the mercenary group interface.

Han Xiao's goal in building a mercenary group was this group of players. This was a group of ready-made coolies … no, warriors. Being a mercenary was a dangerous profession, but the players could be revived and would not suffer any losses. This was a good opportunity to take advantage of the players' natural advantages. With such hardworking members, it would be much easier to develop. The players were the best help.

"Let the players join my mercenary group, and we can form a faction."

Han Xiao's eyes were deep, and the corners of his mouth curled up slightly.

Building a faction was an extremely core part of his plan. He wanted to be on the same side as the players and tie the players to his war chariot. This would increase the cohesion of the players and greatly reduce the chances of the players leaving. This was the plan that Han Xiao came up with in advance.

It was also a step forward in his relationship with the players, from a purely beneficial relationship to a higher level, and he had truly become one of them!

Think about it, if he were to establish a mercenary group, the initial members would all be professional players. This in itself would be a gimmick that would attract the attention of many players. Then, he would use rewards to attract professional players to work hard. As the mercenary group grew stronger, they would think that it was his own work.

It emphasized that the contribution of players could promote the growth of the faction. Players would feel that their struggle for the faction was meaningful, and they would view the faction's achievements as their own. From there, they would feel a sense of satisfaction, accomplishment, and belonging.

Do not underestimate the sense of belonging. This kind of thing would become feelings after a long time of nurturing. The killing power of feelings to players was not just a little scary, it would cultivate fanatical loyalty!

For most players, the game was for fun. Adding in role-playing elements, allowing players to choose a faction and adhere to their ideals, this would bring a strong sense of immersion, and this kind of gameplay would attract players! Everyone had a burning passion in their heart, they had a vision of loyalty, and they had heroic fantasies of dying for a certain faction. However, in the so-called "reality", these feelings were suppressed by rationality. In the game, there was a chance to release these feelings, and there were no consequences. What Han Xiao wanted to do was to draw out these feelings in the hearts of the players and attach them to himself!

Han Xiao wanted to build his faction into the hope of the players, and Han Technician himself would lead the faction, perfectly blending into the players and becoming the "leader" in the hearts of the players. As the faction grew, Han Xiao would be able to obtain more benefits. He could obtain good things and use them as rewards to attract players to contribute to the faction. It would enter a virtuous cycle, and a large number of players would become his support.

The mercenary group was the initial stage of the plan. Through Pork Bun's show, he would constantly make his presence known and entrenched his position. When more players entered the galaxy in the future versions, as long as he raised his arm and shouted, there would definitely be players who would want to join him.

Of course, this was only the theory. The actual operation was more complicated, and it would take a long time to take shape. However, once it was successful, it would become the brand of a generation of players, just like Wow's Alliance and Horde, which would last for a long time.

This was Han Xiao's grand blueprint!

"You guys register as mercenaries and join my mercenary group. I will take care of you." Han Xiao's tone was full of temptation.

Mad Blade did not hesitate and was the first to do so. He had always followed two principles. First, there would be meat to eat if he followed Han Xiao. Second, everything Han Xiao said was right.

The players joined one after another, and Han Xiao watched with a smile on his face. It was like watching seeds being planted in the soil, taking root and germinating was just around the corner.

The screen quickly changed to a new interface.

Black Star Mercenary

Credibility: 10

Size: 47 people

Grade C: 47 people

Missions Completed: 0

Active Area: None

Experience: None

Founder: Black Star – Han Xiao

Creation Date: Galaxy Calendar, Year 688, October 2

Summary: Trainee mercenary group, small in size, average strength of members, no obvious advantages

A mercenary group was newly established and unknown. There were three criteria to judge a mercenary group: size, strength, and credibility. The first two were the screening criteria for matching missions, and credibility was equivalent to the 'level' of the mercenary group. Only by completing missions could one accumulate credibility, which represented the reputation of the mercenary group.

Many employers had requirements for the credibility of the mercenaries. If the credibility was too low, the employer could reject the mercenary who applied for the mission.

Credibility was also equivalent to fame. Of course, the profile would not show a more abstract value like 'fame', but the reputation system on the interface had digitized the fame of the mercenary group, and only Han Xiao could see it directly.

Li Ge and the Temple of God team were not present. They were the only ones who did not join, and Han Xiao was a little dissatisfied.

At this time, a notification suddenly appeared on Han Xiao's interface.

Faction Creation: Black Star Mercenary

Faction Management Function Activated

A new option appeared in the NPC template, [Faction Management], right next to [Dungeon Creation].

"Just as I thought!" Han Xiao's eyes lit up, and he was pleasantly surprised.

Ever since the dungeon creation function appeared, he had been thinking about what other functions were hidden in the NPC template. Faction was obviously a very common function, but he had not triggered it for a long time. Therefore, he guessed that he was attached to the Dark Net, but the boss was Bennett, so this function had not been activated.

He was eighty percent sure that only when he created his own faction would the interface show feedback, and he guessed right.

If the interface did not show any reaction, he had planned to use his love to create a faction. Now that he had the system management of the interface, it was very beneficial for his faction development plan.

Han Xiao quickly entered the [Faction Management] interface to familiarize himself with the function. After a while, his eyes became more and more excited.

One word could describe this function:

Do whatever you want!
